channel.title: Taula articles
channel.description: Long-form writing from the Taula project: databases, coding agents, local models, and the engineering behind a native macOS database manager.

item.title: Give your coding agent a database it can't break
item.description: Coding agents are good at reading a schema and should never be trusted with one. How Taula's read-only gate works, what keyword scanning catches, what it can't, and why the database role is the boundary that matters.
